info.title: Harakiri Sandbox API
info.description: Control-plane API for sandbox lifecycle, templates, Credential Vault, routes, registry credentials, and account settings.

post.description: Atomically reserves an organization execution slot before credential issuance or runtime creation. Reuse Idempotency-Key for the same intent after a lost response. wait:false means admitted provisioning, not an overflow queue.

409.description: organization_capacity_exceeded: no execution was admitted; stop work or raise the limit. idempotency_conflict: key reused for a different intent. sandbox_transition_in_progress: existing runtime effect must settle.

503.description: organization_capacity_unavailable: inventory is unverified or unavailable; no new execution was admitted.

delete.description: Acceptance does not prove runtime absence. Poll the sandbox and organization capacity until cleanup is confirmed.

get.description: Read-only, uncached health observation. Lifecycle running alone does not establish readiness. This does not check user applications or free an execution slot on failure. Requires sandboxes:read.

get.description: Requires org:read. Counts held execution reservations, not running observations, host resources or billing. Counts are null while inventory is reconciling or quarantined.

error.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Sandbox runtime endpoints use the SandboxRuntimeApiErrorCode vocabulary.

SandboxRuntimeApiErrorCode.description: Stable error codes used or reserved by public sandbox runtime endpoints.

workspaceId.description: Exclusive organization workspace attachment. Cannot be combined with snapshotId.

wait.description: Defaults to true: wait for execution-service readiness. false accepts provisioning asynchronously.

waitTimeoutMs.description: Maximum create wait in milliseconds. An exhausted wait returns HTTP 202 with the accepted sandbox ID; it does not cancel or recreate it.

contract.description: Where the capability is implemented: formal OpenSandbox API/spec, current OpenSandbox provider behavior, Harakiri control-plane overlay, unavailable in this provider, or unsupported.

source.description: Human-readable provider or control-plane source for this capability.

scopes.description: Omitted: runtime profile. Sensitive scopes require a human admin; keys cannot manage keys.

expiresAt.description: Future expiry within 365 days; defaults to 90 days. New keys cannot be non-expiring.

computeHours.description: Unmeasured; zero is a numeric compatibility placeholder, not observed usage. Consult coverage.

avgColdStartMs.description: Unmeasured; template boot estimates are not observed cold starts. Consult coverage.

avgRuntimeSeconds.description: Unmeasured; zero is a numeric compatibility placeholder. Consult coverage.

concurrentPeak.description: Unmeasured; zero is a compatibility placeholder, not an observed peak.

UsageOutcomeCounts.description: Latest terminal operation records grouped by completed_at, not an append-only attempt log. A retried operation may revise an earlier outcome count.

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum execution reservations; lowering the limit never evicts existing work.

expectedCapacityRevision.description: Required when maxConcurrency is supplied. A stale revision returns 409 organization_capacity_settings_conflict.
